---
title: Razor Clam Soup
id: MAR-0121
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 1.2 kg of razor clams
- 400 g of tomatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley
- 4 slices of country bread
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Let the razor clams purge sand in salted water for an hour.
2. Blanch the tomatoes, drain, peel, remove seeds and chop.
3. Open the razor clams in a covered pan for about 5 minutes.
4. Shell them and filter their liquid.
5. Peel the onion, chop it and let it wilt for 5 minutes in the oil.
6. Add the tomatoes and after 10 minutes the razor clams with their liquid, mix and turn off the heat.
7. Toast the bread in the oven at 220 °C for 5 minutes and place in deep plates; distribute the soup and serve.
